title: The Fiery Furnace
reflectionQuestion: Have you ever had to make a choice knowing it could cost you everything?
reflectionText: They were given a choice: bow or burn. They said: even if he does not. That line is the hinge of the story. Not "God will save us," though they believed it — but "even if he does not." What is it to make the decision about who you are before the answer comes about what will happen?

scriptureKeyVerse.text: If it happens, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king.
